lines.x: Hm… Hmm… Hmmm… Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?
This is a floral tea that I made myself, Doctor. Come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day.
The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfy. Even if I'm in charge here, it sometimes makes me want to sit down and relax for a bit.
Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget their sorrows and worries. That's probably a gardener's primary objective, don't you think?
I much prefer gardening to fighting. But as long as I think about how I'm helping everyone, I can muster up the courage to go into combat.
These bottles? They're the pollen and seeds I've been collecting. I usually put on a gas mask and gloves before handling them, to protect me from poison.
Hm, everyone seems a bit weary these days. But, when they see the flowers I've planted, I'm sure they'll cheer right up.

Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? Everyone's been awfully busy the last few days… If nobody comes by the greenhouse, they're going to miss the blooming season. And wouldn't that be a terrible shame?
Tending the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as the flowers I grow can make people smile, all my hard work will be worth it!
Doctor? Oh, you're asleep… May the flowery fragrance waft over your dreams.
Doctor, it's Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love for you to come by the greenhouse!
Oh… I was expecting a video about gardening.
Artist? N-N-No, I'm not that talented. I'm just a normal gardener.
Look, Doctor! These are the new varieties I've been tending for so long. They've finally started to bloom! Aren't they gorgeous?
Hm? Am I going too?
Um, I've only ever tended a greenhouse. Can I really help with this…?
I see the enemy! Let's go!
Everybody, look after yourselves!
Yes?
Where are we going?
Got it.
I'll do it.
Careful, this pollen is allergenic.
Okay, I'll handle this.
I've seen weeds like these before.
Let me protect everyone!
Phew, are we safe already? Good job, everyone!
Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.
Doctor, everyone is waiting for your next orders.
Ah… I never thought it would turn out like this…
Should we plant some flowers over here?
Oh, Doctor?
Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?
Arknights.

Back home, most flowers would already have withered by now. But just thinking about how spring will be here soon… fills my heart with hope. Doctor, let's find the first flower that blooms in the greenhouse together!
Hello, Doctor!

Doctor, happy birthday! Please, try this floral tea! I made it the way Miss Lena taught me, and if you really savor it, you can taste a hint of cake flavor! Eh? You can't? Let me try… Oh… Sorry, Doctor. I… I think I forgot the honey…

I've been all over with Rhodes Island. Does that mean I've spread flowery fragrance to just as many places? Hehe… I may still have lots of room for improvement, compared to Miss Lena, but I'll do my best to make Rhodes Island an even warmer place!
